newsitem.title: BELGIUM: DUTCH SWINE FEVER OUTBREAK SPREADS TO BELGIUM.
newsitem.headline: DUTCH SWINE FEVER OUTBREAK SPREADS TO BELGIUM.

text.p: The swine fever outbreak that has devastated the Dutch pig market this year has spread to Belgium, despite border controls being in place for months, Belgian BRTN television reported on Tuesday.
BRTN said a total of 4,000 pigs had had to be destroyed at a farm in Bocholt, northern Belgium, near the Dutch border.

"This is a serious case of swine fever. It is a big company which had many contacts withother companies, we will see what further action needs to be taken," Belgian Agriculture Minister Karel Pinxten told BRTN.
